merchant/30893.htm.text: Trader Payel: Welcome to Heine! Do you know about the legendary wedding of Knight Roland Hunter and Elf Aridne in Innadrill? Their love story has been passed down as a wandering minstrel's song. It's lovely... Now, what kind of item are you looking for? We carry a large number of pigments and vario…

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30893-pk.htm.text: Trader Payel: I am sorry, but the Lord strictly forbids dealing with murderers and renegades. I couldn't even if I wanted to, and I don't.
